scope: The 2 admitted X509_VERIFY_POLICY production obligation(s) in src/x509/v3_attrmap.rs that the enumerated SSH closure reports as reachable but without an owning boundary receipt are enumerated here for ownership only, at their census coordinates, with a hazard read from each function. This receipt claims no discharge, no contract and no new reachability finding.
non_claims: This receipt does not discharge any site, and no site may be treated as discharged on its authority.
This receipt does not contract any site; the hazard notes are enumeration notes, not established contracts.
This receipt does not assert reachability; reachability is taken from the enumerated closure and is not re-established here.

boundaries.hazard: Raw OSSL_ATTRIBUTE_MAPPING is dereferenced and the type_ selector chooses a union arm; the chosen mapping's object and value pointers are forwarded to raw printers.
Raw STACK_OF(OSSL_ATTRIBUTE_MAPPING) is iterated and each element forwarded to i2r_ATTRIBUTE_MAPPING; stack liveness and element type are caller obligations.
